title: CoinQuest
desc: A 3D adventure game made in Unity 6. You collect coins while enemies chase you, and every level is generated fresh from a seed.
features: Levels generated from a seed, so each run plays differently
Enemies that patrol, spot you and chase you using pathfinding
HUD with coin counter, score and a quick restart
challenge: Getting the difficulty right was the hard part. Fixed enemy speed was either too easy or unfair, so enemies now speed up gradually based on how well you're doing.
